modmenu.descriptionTranslation.where_win: Adds fuller vanilla grass coverage to grassy biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.title: Where Winds Blow
where_winds_blow.config.subtitle: Terrain needs the full mod on the world/server. Rendering works client-side.
where_winds_blow.config.terrain.title: Terrain Settings
where_winds_blow.config.rendering.title: Rendering Settings
where_winds_blow.config.rendering.note: Rendering changes apply on the client immediately and work without a server install.
where_winds_blow.config.worldgen.note: Terrain changes require the full mod on the world/server and only affect new chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDenseGrass: Turns this mod's added grass world generation on or off. Requires a world reload and only affects newly generated chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.denseGrassDensit: Multiplies dense short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.mediumGrassDensi: Multiplies medium short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.sparseGrassDensi: Multiplies sparse short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallGrassPatchMu: Multiplies tall grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.shortDryGrassPat: Multiplies short dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallDryGrassPatc: Multiplies tall dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.deadGrassPatchMu: Multiplies dead grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.overgrownGrassPa: Multiplies overgrown grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.wildWheatPatchMu: Multiplies wild wheat patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.enableFoliageInt: Lets nearby entities push and bend supported foliage on the client.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageInteracti: Scales how strongly supported foliage reacts when entities move through it.
where_winds_blow.config.enableAutodetect: Lets Where Winds Blow animate compatible plant-like models from Minecraft and other mods.
where_winds_blow.config.enableCustomFoli: Uses Where Winds Blow's custom foliage shader for vanilla cutout foliage render types.
Enables the bright moving sheen that travels across responsive foliage in the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windSheenStrengt: Scales the visible intensity of the wind sheen highlight.
where_winds_blow.config.forceWwbWindWith: Use WWB Wind With Shader Packs
Keeps Where Winds Blow sway and sheen active even when an Iris shader pack is currently rendering.
where_winds_blow.config.enableSodiumShad: Adds Where Winds Blow wind uniforms and source injections to Sodium's own terrain shader.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindFoliag: Enables wind-driven sway in the responsive foliage shader.
where_winds_blow.config.windFoliageSwayS: Scales the strength of wind-driven foliage motion.
